nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Chuyện vặt hằng ngày · bài tự soạn
L: B
Hi there! You must be the new neighbor in 4B.
A
That's me! I'm Dana. I just moved in last weekend.
B
Nice to meet you, Dana. I'm Lee, from 4A. How are you settling in?
A
So far so good, though I'm still surrounded by boxes.
B
I know the feeling. If you need anything, just knock on my door.
A
Thanks, that's really kind. Actually, do you know when the trash gets collected?
B
Tuesdays and Fridays, early in the morning. You'll hear the truck.
A
Good to know. Sorry in advance if my music gets loud.
B
No problem. By the way, we're having a get-together in the courtyard on Saturday. Come by if you're free!
A
I'd love to! I'll bring some snacks. See you then!

exq.q: Which apartment does Lee live in?
exq.why: “I'm Lee, from 4A” = Lee ở căn 4A (Dana ở 4B).
